description: Generate presentations with Gamma - start a generation from text or a multi-page outline, follow it to completion, read and export the finished gamma, and browse the workspace's themes and folders.

api.description: Start a Gamma 5 agent generation from one brief, with a theme, template, quality preset and up to 10 source URLs. Spends credits

fields.description: The brief: what to generate. The only required field.
Defaults to `presentation`. A webpage needs `generations.create`.
Target cards, capped by the plan’s maximum.
An accessible workspace template.
A quality preset; `max` spends more credits.
Up to 10 pages the agent reads as source material.
Opt this run out of the workspace’s connectors.

fields.description: Options Gamma ignored or could not apply. Keep them: the status read does not always repeat them.
